'''Mendel Baudo Shipyards''' was a [[Starship/Legends|shipwright company]] founded by the reclusive and eccentric [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Mendel Baudo]]. The company owned small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that produced the [[Baudo-class star yacht|''Baudo''-class star yacht]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="FC" />
